changed-minecraft-mod.desc: A Minecraft experience in the world of Changed.

changed-vanilla.desc: Addon mod for Changed containing transfurs for vanilla Minecraft mobs.

changed-addon-plus.desc: Adds new mechanics to Changed: MC Mod, including survival Untransfurmation, New Transfurs and more features

changed-additions.desc: Adds extra content to the Changed Mod by LtxProgrammer but keeping a Vanilla style

changed-synergy.desc: Turns aggressive latex creatures into neighbors you can actually get along with. An orange or a friendly pat will often get you further than fists and blades. Transfur is not always the end anymore cause sometimes you can even talk your way back out of it!

changed-extra.desc: Technology is our mission: to develop better forms and understand latex creatures themselves.

changedextras.desc: The Changed: Minecraft Mod Addon that adds creatures, features and structures that just won't be implemented by the other addons or the main mod.

changed-siren-course.desc: Become a cursed siren or shark mermaid in the Changed universe, where water is your life and your curse.

changed-true-transfur.desc: True Transfur is an add‑on to Changed that will change the rules of the game. A full‑fledged Transformation system and the INSTINCT mode.

additional-transfurs.desc: Some additional transfurs to changed minecraft mod.

changed-untransfur.desc: A simple untransfur mod for the changed minecraft mod.

un-safe-transfur.desc: A mod about getting transfurred in not necesarily the safest ways.

latexs-delight.desc: An extention to Farmer's Delight that adapts the items and creatures from the ChangedMC or Changed mod.

changed-survive-protocol.desc: Survival expansion for the Changed-Minecraft Mod.

furmutage-mod-early-testing-a-changed-ad.desc: This is an addon for the changed minecraft mod, right now it is super early access, and adds concepts and ideas that are not fully baked but are almost ready.

changed-pooltoys-tfs.desc: A Changed addon mod that adds all the tfs into a pooltoy variant

latex-caves.desc: Latex Caves Dimension using Changed: Minecraft Mod

changed-ai-boss.desc: AI-powered dynamic English combat dialogue for Changed Addon Plus bosses. Early Alpha, Zhipu-only, more providers coming.

changedarmy.desc: Adds latex creature squads and hostile outposts, makes human‑player survival more challenging. Requires Changed MC 1.15.0 or higher

goopcattech.desc: Strangest but Cutest Tech Mod around :3

peos-custom-transfurs.desc: Adds custom transfurs for the changed mod

changed-doomsday.desc: A mod that allows you to make your Changed experiences more challenging with new gamerules, configurations, and data packs.

changed-more-music-discs.desc: Adds more music discs that are survival-friendly.
